newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise shuts Nelson field till Friday.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise shuts Nelson field till Friday.

text.p: Production at the North Sea Nelson oil field has been shut down at least until Friday because of a minor technical problem, a spokesman for operator Enterprise Oil said on Wednesday.
"It was shut down sometime last night...it will be down until Friday, possibly Saturday," he said.
The total shutdown was due to "the failure of a small peripheral piece of pipe" in the water system, the spokesman said.
Enterprise said on Monday that it planned to cut output at the 150,000 barrels per day (bpd) field to less than 50,000 bpd towards the end of the week to allow repairs to gas dehydration equipment.
Nelson crude feeds into the Forties system and two Forties cargoes scheduled to load in July have already been deferred to August.

The spokesman said that although the water system fault was small, difficulties in isolating the pipe would mean a fairly lengthy shutdown. Engineers were currently evaluating two possible repair methods.
Maintenance work on a faulty gas compressor took average production at Nelson down to just 25,000 bpd in June.
